user.title: BAS Wire Sheet for TEMCO
user.description: Needs the BACnet IP integration with your TEMCO controllers added, and UDP 47808 open from Home Assistant to each controller. More settings (per controller, MS/TP routers, Node-RED) are under Configure after setup.

data.full_access_all_devices: Full access to every TEMCO controller

data_description.full_access_all_devices: All program slots and every point, physical outputs included. Off: restricted mode (configure each controller under Configure > Controller).

data_description.program_watch_time: A change of this time applies after a restart.
